visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Zero Has No Digits
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The number 0 has one digit, but the program prints 0 digits for it. Other numbers are fine.

solution.explanation: A while loop tests before running, so for n = 0 the body never runs and the count stays 0. A do-while runs the body once first, which counts the single digit of 0.
